# Basalt OS GRUB theme. Generated by the Basalt OS branding kit
# (brand/basalt-os/src/build.py); edit the generator, not this file.
#
# Dark background, the Basalt OS lockup, the entries on a dark panel, the
# selected entry in ink with a terra roxa edge, icons by entry class, a
# countdown with a progress line and the keys at the bottom. Positions are
# relative to the screen, so the layout fits every mode from 1024x768 up;
# grub.cfg asks for 1920x1080 first (basalt-theme.cfg).
#
# Text: "Unifont Regular 16", the font inside Fedora's signed GRUB image. With Secure
# Boot on, GRUB refuses font files from disk, so a theme font would never
# load on most Basalt systems; the key hints are an image instead.
# Serial terminals never use a theme: they get GRUB's text menu.

title-text: ""
desktop-image: "background.png"
desktop-image-scale-method: "crop"
desktop-color: "#14171B"
message-font: "Unifont Regular 16"
message-color: "#E3E6EA"
message-bg-color: "#14171B"
terminal-font: "Unifont Regular 16"
terminal-box: "term_*.png"
terminal-left: "8%"
terminal-top: "10%"
terminal-width: "84%"
terminal-height: "78%"
terminal-border: "8"

+ image {
    left = 50%-96
    top = 12%
    width = 193
    height = 64
    file = "logo.png"
}

+ boot_menu {
    left = 18%
    top = 12%+116
    width = 64%
    height = 50%-116
    menu_pixmap_style = "panel_*.png"
    item_font = "Unifont Regular 16"
    selected_item_font = "Unifont Regular 16"
    item_color = "#B4BAC2"
    selected_item_color = "#FFFFFF"
    item_height = 40
    item_padding = 14
    item_spacing = 10
    icon_width = 24
    icon_height = 24
    item_icon_space = 14
    selected_item_pixmap_style = "select_*.png"
    scrollbar = true
    scrollbar_width = 4
    scrollbar_frame = "scroll_frame_*.png"
    scrollbar_thumb = "scroll_thumb_*.png"
    scrollbar_left_pad = 6
    scrollbar_right_pad = 0
}

+ label {
    id = "__timeout__"
    left = 18%
    top = 62%+28
    width = 64%
    height = 20
    align = "center"
    color = "#B4BAC2"
    font = "Unifont Regular 16"
    text = "The selected entry starts in %d s"
}

# The countdown line. GRUB makes a progress bar at least one text line tall
# (16 pixels) and stretches bar_c and barfill_c to that height, so both are
# 1x16 images with a 3 pixel line in the middle and nothing above or below.
+ progress_bar {
    id = "__timeout__"
    left = 50%-140
    top = 62%+56
    width = 280
    height = 16
    bar_style = "bar_*.png"
    highlight_style = "barfill_*.png"
}

+ image {
    left = 50%-304
    top = 100%-66
    width = 608
    height = 26
    file = "keys.png"
}
